name: Snap-On Incorporated
research_rationale: Q3 10-Q shows nine-month sales ahead of last year and net cash, but Q3 earnings fell year on year and goodwill rose with acquisitions; research still supports accumulate versus the strong-buy screen.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 FY2026 10-Q (filed 22 Oct): nine-month net sales rose about 3% year on year, but Q3 net earnings were roughly 8% below the prior-year quarter; cash of about $1.67bn exceeded total debt.
Goodwill increased after FY2026 bolt-ons (e.g. Diesel Laptops); $300m notes due 2027 are in current maturities.
News since 18 Sep cites a dividend increase and franchisee destocking in the Tools Group, partly offset by industrial/C&I demand themes in commentary.
